data.title: Retail - CUSTOMER ASSISTANT
data.descriptionHtml:
Role Overview
As a Customer Assistant, your role is to help create thoughtful and joyful experiences in-store. The kind that stay with people long after they’ve walked out the door. You’ll bring energy, warmth, and integrity to everything you do; whether it’s delivering exceptional service, supporting your teammates, or helping your store shine.
This is a hands-on, people-first role where no two days are the same - and we love that.
What You’ll Do
  • Create meaningful customer moments with personalised service and genuine care
  • Support store performance by working together and following through on what matters
  • Merchandise with intention - keeping the space inspiring, beautiful, and brand-aligned
  • Be a go-to expert on our range, using your product knowledge to help customers find the right scent, gift, or moment
  • Keep things moving, support your teammates, and help create a workplace that’s as fun as it is focused
About You
  • You care about people, and it shows; in your service, your attitude, and your follow-through
  • You bring warmth, curiosity, and a can-do mindset to every shift
  • You’re reliable, collaborative, and proud to be someone your team can count on
  • You’re always learning and love growing alongside your team
  • You know that great culture doesn’t just happen... you help create it
What You’ll Love
  • A generous team member discount across our full range of fragrance, décor and gifting
  • Monthly store bonus program and performance-based incentives
  • Recognition that feels real - with shoutouts, milestones, and meaningful celebration
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your immediate family
  • Support to grow with leadership development, coaching and progression opportunities
  • A team and culture where people matter, and every day brings something a little special
Ready to create moments that matter?
Join a team where we keep things fun, lift each other up, and help customers feel at home - one scented moment at a time.
Apply now and start your next chapter with dusk.

data.companyDescription:
Ready to fuel your fire?
Where fine fragrance, innovative design and stylish décor intertwine.

Founded in Perth in 2000, this millennial brand has burnt long and bright, year after year. Proudly Australian, dusk has set the standard for exquisite candles, home fragrance and décor across Australia and New Zealand.

With over 140+ stores across two countries, two dedicated online stores and a Customer Support Centre in Sydney, dusk has been lighting up spaces with glow-worthy products for more than two decades.

With over 450 active product lines in store at any given time, seasonal and limited edition ranges and super-cool, super-exclusive collaborations (think Chupa Chups and Streets Ice-Cream!), there’s always something new and exciting happening at dusk.

We wax lyrical over our iconic range of ever-changing seasonal and core scents, home fragrance technologies and complementary décor pieces to deliver an enchanting addition to a mood, a moment, or create that special memory all in the name of everyday indulgence.

Our Values
We stick by our values like wax to wick. They are the beacon that burns bright, leading our people and culture to build strong teams and development opportunities in a supported working environment.

Walk the Talk
Be A Good Human
Mateship Matters
Give It A Go
Chill And Prosper

Incentives
We believe the key to a happy team is through regular training, feedback, rewards and recognition.

Learning and Development

data.title: Canteen Assistant
data.descriptionHtml:
Canteen Assistant – Casual (High School Cafeteria)

North of the River

We are seeking a reliable, honest and flexible casual staff member to join our very busy high school canteen located north of the river. This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced environment, ideal for team players with a strong work ethic.

Start Date: Immediately

Hours: Approximately 16- 25 hours per week

Availability: Hours available during school terms only (school holidays off)

Employment Type: Casual

Pay Rate: In accordance with the Fast Food Industry Award $33.19 per hour(Over 21 years old)

Permanent residents only need to apply

Key Responsibilities

  • Food preparation
  • Basic cooking skills (not essential but beneficial)
  • Counter service
  • EFTPOS and cash handling
  • Cleaning and washing up
  • Packing away deliveries
  • Replenishing stock in kitchen and service areas
  • Maintaining excellent customer service standards
  • Following instructions efficiently

Essential Requirements

  • High levels of personal hygiene
  • Honest, reliable and consistently punctual
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to learn new tasks quickly
  • Flexible availability and willingness to work any shift required

Mandatory Requirements

  • Working With Children Check (current or willing to obtain)
  • Food Safety Certificate (free online course acceptable)

Desirable Skills

  • Strong money-handling skills and mental math skills
  • Previous experience in food service, hospitality or canteen work (preferred but not essential)

How to Apply

Please send your resume via email. Shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Job Type: Casual

Pay: $33.19 per hour

Work Authorisation:

  • Australia (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

data.title: Educator | Casual (3 Month Contract)
data.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

Beyond the Paycheck (Benefits & Perks)

At lululemon, we care for and invest in the whole person - body, mind, spirit. Our total rewards program is designed to support you in achieving your goals and focus on the things you love. In addition to competitive base pay and a team-based bonus program, we also offer paid time off, generous employee discounts, fitness/yoga classes, parenthood top up program and personal and professional development programs.

Note: availability of these benefits and perks may be subject to your location and employment type and may have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these benefits and perks in whole or in part at anytime without advance notice.

Job Summary

The Educator role is the foundation of our success as an organization. Educators are experts in creating world-class customer service, or guest experience, in our retail stores. They are responsible for engaging and connecting with our guests, sharing top-quality product education, and speaking authentically about our community and culture.

Core Responsibilities of the Job

Guest (i.e., Customer) Experience

  • Interact with guests to ensure a great guest experience in a manner that values guests' time.
  • Assess guests' needs to provide customized, effective purchase and return solutions and support.
  • Provide technical product education by articulating the value and benefit of the product.
  • Facilitate a seamless end-to-end guest experience by conducting accurate and timely guest transactions and executing market-relevant omnichannel programs (e.g., buy online/pickup in store, phone sales, and ship from store options) according to company standards.
  • Move dynamically on the floor to continuously engage with guests and attend to guest or store needs.
  • Receive guest feedback and partner with store leadership to take appropriate action and "make it right" for guests.
Working with Others

  • Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and celebrating differences to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests.
  • Establish supportive and productive relationships with all team members.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure optimal guest experience and support store operations.
Operations

  • Perform product presentation tasks (e.g., put items back in place, restock or add depleted items to the floor from inventory, destock or relocate items) according to company standards.
  • Use in-store technology to support store operations and provide positive guest experiences.
  • Perform cleaning tasks as needed throughout the shift to maintain the luxury environment of the store.
  • Understand and adhere to people safety policies and procedures to maintain a safe work environment.
  • Perform work in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and laws or regulations.
Job Requirements

Eligibility

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the store is located
  • Must have the ability to travel to assigned store with reliable transportation methods
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
Schedule/Availability
  • The work schedule can vary based on store needs
  • Work occurs on a variable schedule which could include early mornings, mornings, afternoons, evenings, late nights or overnights, as well as weekends and holidays
  • In addition, the schedule may include times when the store is closed to guests
Job Assets (i.e., nice to have; not required)

  • Education: High school diploma/GED/equivalent, or above
What We Look For

  • Attention to Detail: Is careful about detail and thorough in completing work tasks
  • Being Organized: Prioritizes and completes assigned tasks efficiently and accurately
  • Drive: Is self-motivated and determined to meet or exceed goals
  • Safety Orientation: Is committed to complying with safety rules and guidelines
  • Personal Responsibility: Accepts responsibility/accountability for actions; is dependabl
  • Inclusion & Diversity: Creates/supports an inclusive environment that values/celebrates differences
  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Works productively with and supports others to achieve common goals; seeks connections, partnerships, and diverse perspectives
  • Adaptability/Agility: Navigates uncertainty and ambiguity and can change priorities in a fast-paced environment; recovers quickly from setbacks
Work Context (e.g., environment, interactions, physical)
  • Work involves moving through the store, sometimes on the sales floor with bright lights and loud music, and sometimes in areas with no windows or natural light
  • Work is accomplished as part of a team, sometimes independently, and sometimes using a computer or other technology
  • Work may involve moving boxes weighing up to 30 lbs (13.6 kg) or using ladders to reach materials
Applicants successful in progressing to interview will be contacted by a Manager or a member of the People & Culture team. Please note any applicant or employee who needs a reasonable adjustment to perform the essential duties of the job is encouraged to discuss this with the Manager or People and Culture team member when arranging the interview so we can ensure an equitable, barrier-free application process.

data.title: Electrical/Calibration Technician-Junior
data.descriptionHtml:
The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Electrical / Calibration Technician to support testing, calibration, and commissioning activities across electrical and automation systems. This role is suited to a junior candidate with a strong foundational understanding of electrical engineering principles, combined with practical exposure to PLC systems, instrumentation, and fault finding.

You will work closely with engineers and senior technicians on real-world industrial projects, contributing to system accuracy, reliability, and compliance.

Qualifications & experience

  • Minimum 2 year calibration experience relating to dimensional, pressure ,torque and electrical .
  • Qualification in Electrical Engineering (Degree, Diploma, or equivalent)
  • Exposure to SCADA or control system environments
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and technical drawings
  • Practical experience with testing, troubleshooting, and fault finding
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly in calibration and documentation
  • MS Office proficient
  • Professional presentation and approach to the job, colleagues and clients
  • Able to work autonomously on a day to day basis and manage time effectively
  • Current unrestricted driver’s licence (Australian recognised)
  • Ideally ,keen understanding of ISO 17025 and relevant standards and test methods used for various calibrations.
  • Exposure to robotics or automated systems
  • Experience using engineering or CAD software (e.g. AutoCAD, Inventor)
  • Understanding of AS/NZS electrical standards and compliance requirements
  • Experience in industrial environments such as manufacturing, water treatment, or automation projects
  • Programming knowledge (e.g. Python, C and Metcal)
  • Additive manufacturing and fixture design capabilities

Tasks & responsibilities

  • Pressure Calibration, pressure gauges,calibrators
  • Torque Calibration, Torque wrenches , including repairs
  • Dimensional Calibrations, micrometers, verniers, height gauges, etc
  • Temperature Calibrations, Thermometers, Infrared guns and Thermal imagers
  • Electrical Calibrations, Multimeters, Clamp-meters, Insulation Testers
  • Electronics repair of various instrumentation
  • Onsite field calibrations and installations
  • Troubleshooting and maintenance of field instrumentation
  • Designing and validating test systems and procedures for calibration
  • Automation of calibration systems using various software packages, eg Python, C+, Metcal, Labview.
  • Additive manufacturing and fixture design capabilities

Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Forrestdale WA 6112

data.title: Retail Sales Consultant
data.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced salesperson to work at our retail store in Neutral Bay. This is a casual role with a differing roster each week offering 6 – 18 hours work per week (including Saturdays). The role would perfectly suit a former real estate agent (or someone with comparable training or experience) who is looking to return to the workforce on a casual basis and enjoy the sales buzz they crave.

Must have experience in identifying, qualifying, assisting, and closing leads. Leads generally come from clients visiting the store (planned and unplanned visits), online enquiries, and mining our CRM database of previous clients. No outbound cold calling is required. Full training in our tangible range of products will be provided. Our Director will support you with regular discussions on sales strategies and your allocated targets/KPIs.

Our luxury product range requires someone who is immaculately groomed and provides an exceptional customer service experience. As a retail environment you will also be required to help with store presentation including standard vacuuming and dusting, plus other general retail tasks such as payment processing, opening and closing the premises, creating product displays, etc. Following your paid training shifts working alongside another team member, you will generally be working solo within the store however our Director and a team member from our second store location will also be available to communicate with and assist you remotely with any queries.

Retail award rates plus super is provided. Incentives can be negotiated for the right candidate.

If this role suits you, please send your CV and a brief description of your sales experience to kbor3270@gmail.com

Job Type: Casual

Pay: $30.00 – $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 6 – 18 per week

Benefits:

  • Employee discount

data.title: Landscape Tradesperson - Construction
data.descriptionHtml:
Landscape Tradesperson – Construction

Full-time | Immediate Start

About the role

Civilscape is seeking an experienced Landscape Construction Tradesperson to join our delivery team. This role is construction-focused only and suited to candidates with strong practical experience in landscape and civil external works.

You will work on well-planned commercial, civil and public domain projects as part of a structured and professional team.

Key responsibilities

  • Carry out landscape construction works to approved drawings and specifications
  • Set out works, including levels and falls
  • Construct paving, concrete paths and hardscape elements
  • Build retaining walls (block, timber and modular systems)
  • Install edging, steps, kerbs and associated finishes
  • Assist with drainage, subgrade preparation and base works
  • Operate tools and machinery safely and efficiently
  • Maintain site safety, quality and presentation standards

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience in landscape construction
  • Strong understanding of setting out, levels and falls
  • Practical experience with:
  • Paving (concrete, stone, porcelain)
  • Concrete paths, slabs and finishes
  • Retaining walls (segmental, timber, block systems)
  • Subsoil drainage and base preparation
  • Ability to read plans and follow construction details
  • Reliable, safety-focused and team-oriented
  • White Card and current driver’s licence (essential)

Formal qualifications are advantageous; however, demonstrated construction experience is critical.

What we offer

  • Full-time, stable employment
  • Company vehicle provided (fully maintained)
  • Paid rain days
  • Quality tools, equipment and resources
  • Consistent pipeline of construction projects
  • Clear pathway to leading hand or site supervision roles

About Civilscape

Civilscape is a Sydney-based external works contractor delivering landscape construction and civil packages across public, commercial and infrastructure projects. We value planning, quality workmanship and long-term careers.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $95,000.00 – $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Company car
  • Employee mentoring program
  • Professional development assistance

data.title: Customer Service Officer/ Licence Testing Officer
data.descriptionHtml:
At VicRoads the work you do has real impact. Our work connects people and communities. We keep Victorians moving safely and smoothly today and help them be ready for tomorrow.

VicRoads empowers our people to learn and grow– focusing on impact and innovation. We reflect the diversity of Victoria and foster clever thinking to keep you and the community moving.

VicRoads is progressing too. In August 2022, we started on a new chapter when the Victorian State Government partnered with Aware Super, Australian Retirement Trust, and Macquarie Asset Management to operate registration and licensing services on its behalf.

We work collaboratively with the Victorian State Government to ensure we fulfill regulatory requirements, deliver State projects and safeguard customer data. The Victorian State Government retains sole responsibility for road access, infrastructure and safety.

Salary: $64,066 - $69,294 plus Super
Tenure: Full-time/ max term (24 months)
Location: Sale

About the role:

Numbering over 800 staff, our Registration and Licensing (R&L) division significantly contributes to ensuring Victorians are safe on our roads by providing professional customer services, policy advice and specialist services to our customers. data.title: Sales Representative Job
data.descriptionHtml:
At ThatSalesCompany, we are a well-renowned outsourced Sales and Marketing company that represents clients in ways that they cannot themselves, offering our clients endless growth and advancement.

From our unique and effective in-person sales and marketing presentations, we have secured an unbeatable reputation for developing customer relationships, increasing sales and building brand advocacy for our substantial client portfolio. We do this by hiring brilliant people to help achieve our clients’ goals.

We pride ourselves on creating an energetic, supportive, and performance-driven environment. If you’re competitive, goal-oriented, or come from a sports or personal development background, you’ll feel right at home here.

Top Reasons to work at ThatSalesCompany:

  • Central location near hub train and Metro stations
  • Weekly team events
  • Coaching and mentorship from top leaders in the industry
  • Career growth and advancement for the right candidate
  • Optional travel opportunities

Our top sales reps come from a wide range of backgrounds — from hospitality to trades like carpentry.

No prior sales experience? No problem. If you’ve got the right attitude and work ethic, we encourage you to apply.

Job Responsibilities

  • A Sales Representative at ThatSalesCompany will promote and represent client products and campaigns across Australia
  • A SR will Engage with customers face-to-face, including door-to-door and private events
  • A SR will build strong relationships and deliver excellent customer service
  • A SR will Work towards and consistently achieve KPIs and performance targets

Sales Representative Hours

Monday - Thursday - 8.45pm - 6pm

Friday - 8.45am - 2.45pm

Early finish on Fridays for Team Night

What you will need as a Sales Representative at ThatSalesCompany

  • A positive attitude and the ability to talk to people you have never met before
  • 1 year's experience in customer service or sales is preferred but not necessary
  • The ability to work 5 days a week (We dont accept students, Sorry!)
  • Full work rights in Australia (WHV are encouraged to apply)

We encourage people with a strong competitive nature to apply. Our team is a supportive and inclusive team with a wide range of ages. ThatSalesCompany is VERY excited to meet you.

Pay: $70,000.00 – $90,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

We are looking for a skilled and reliable Barista who can consistently produce high-quality coffee while delivering exceptional customer service. This role requires someone confident in handling busy periods, taking accurate orders, and maintaining a clean, professional workspace.

  • A team player with a positive attitude

  • Calm under pressure during busy periods

Benefits:

  • Employee discount

data.title: Plumbing Apprentice Wanted!
data.descriptionHtml:
Plumbing Apprentices Wanted!

Addison Appliances are looking for a young & teachable plumbing apprentice to join our growing team on a full time basis. We offer mentoring, opportunities for growth & promotion and a great workplace culture. If you are keen to develop your plumbing skillset whilst working in a fun & dynamic team then this is the job for you!

In this role you will:

  • Install, replace and remove kitchen, laundry, split systems and hot water appliances
  • Run pipework, fittings and connections to manufacturer specifications
  • Prepare sites, manage materials, and keep work areas clean and safe
  • Learn the regulatory and compliance side of plumbing in Victoria
  • Build customer-facing skills — we represent Addison on every job

We are looking for candidates that:

  • Want to complete a plumbing apprenticeship in its entirety
  • Driver’s licence (essential): current Victorian licence
  • Strong work ethic: you turn up, work hard, and follow through
  • Ambitious and hungry to learn: you want to be a great plumber
  • Reliable and punctual: your team and our customers can count on you
  • Respectful and professional: you take pride in how you carry yourself on site
  • Physically capable: comfortable with manual work and active days

What you get:

  • Competitive wages and full apprentice support
  • Genuine mentorship from experienced installers invested in your growth
  • A young & dynamic team with great culture
  • Variety of work across leading kitchen, laundry and hot water brands
  • Long-term career path with a growing Melbourne business
  • Modern systems and tools — we invest in doing the job properly

For queries and more information, please contact Robert on 0404 492 133.

Please submit your CV below.

Please note that ONLY applicants who submit their CV will be accepted.

Benefits:

data.title: Music Teachers - Piano & Violin
data.descriptionHtml:
Do you play piano or violin? Do you feel passionate about your music and want to pass this on to the next generation of musicians? Do you enjoy working with people of all ages and ability? Then get in touch!

We require a violin teacher for an existing shift on a Tuesday at our Rouse Hill Music School, with additional shifts available depending on your availability.

We require piano teachers for exiting shifts on all days at our Rouse Hill Music School.

Maxx Music currently has over 1,300 students attending lessons across our two schools every week and we are being contacted by new students every day.

This is a great job for young musicians looking for part-time work to go alongside university studies or experienced musicians looking for work to supplement gigging income. Mentoring is provided for musicians who have not taught before.

What will you be doing?

  • Delivering high quality, individual music lessons to our students.
  • Working with students to develop their technique, musicality, performance skills and confidence.
  • Working with some of our students to prepare for AMEB and Rockschool examinations.
  • Inspiring and enthusing students with a lifelong love of music.

Essential

  • For piano, violin, brass and woodwind we require minimum Grade 8 AMEB (or equivalent examining body), CMUS or AMUS welcomed.
  • Strong ability to teach and engage students in a positive, fun-loving manner
  • Clear and confident communicator
  • Enjoy working with music students of all ages, backgrounds and ability
  • Ability to commute / travel to Castle Hill and/or Rouse Hill
  • Attention to detail
  • Available for work between 3pm-8pm weeknights with potential for some weekend working to work within our school of music.
  • Clear understanding of Duty of Care
  • Must possess or be able to apply for a valid Working with Children Check

Valued

  • Confident, outgoing and friendly personality.
  • Strong sense of team.

Teachers must be able to work a minimum of 2 shifts per week during school terms. Shifts can be based around your availability, however they must be the same shifts each week.

School teaching hours: Monday - Thursday 3-8pm, Friday 3-6pm and Saturday 9am-4pm.

Our Rouse Hill School is located close to the Metro and bus station.

Our Castle Hill School is well supported by local buses, although ability to drive is an advantage. This location is approximately 20mins walk from the nearest Metro station.

This position is not suitable for musicians in Australia on a Working Holiday Visa.

Work Remotely

  • No

Job Type: Casual

Pay: $35.00 – $50.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Employee discount

Application Question(s):

  • What instrument/s do you teach?
  • Please tell us about your musical skills and experience
  • What relevant training/qualifications do you have?
  • We are located in Rouse Hill and Castle Hill in NW Sydney. Are you within a reasonable commute of our music schools?

Experience:

  • Teaching: 1 year (Preferred)

Licence/Certification:

  • Working with Children Check (Preferred)

Work Authorisation:

  • Australia (Required)

Work Location: In person

data.title: Storeperson WSE3 - Vaccine Distribution
data.descriptionHtml:
Job no: 937580
Work type: Full time
Location: Adelaide Metro Northern
Categories: Administration, Business and Management
  • Department for Health and Wellbeing – Corporate and Infrastructure Division – Procurement Supply Chain & Management (PSCM)
  • Salary: $1,196 to $1,208 Weekly Paid – WSE3 – Full Time / Ongoing – Permanent

Overview:

The Store Person, Vaccine Warehouse Operations, is responsible for delivering efficient and prompt warehouse and distribution services at the SA Health Vaccine Distribution Centre. Maintaining supply chain activity within a cold storage environment.

The key outcomes for this role are:

  • Upholding and contributing to the Health, Safety and Welfare of themselves and others working at the SA Health Vaccine Distribution centre
  • Efficient and effective handling of vaccine inventory across the receipt, storage, picking, packing and dispatch for the SA Health Vaccine Distribution Centre.
  • Efficient receiving and dispatch operations that meet industry standards for the storage of vaccines and South Australian Health objectives, including:
  • Ensuring accuracy in picking activities and the dispatch and delivery of vaccine orders to service providers.
  • Maintenance of high standards of cleanliness and hygiene within the SA Health Vaccine Distribution Centre.

The incumbent:

  • Must be prepared to be rotated into the ambient SA Health Distribution Centre as required.
  • May be required to work out of business hours including on-call capacity after hours, weekends and public holidays.
  • Will be required to conduct work within cold room temperatures.

data.companyDescription:
SA Health is committed to protecting and improving the health of all South Australians by providing leadership in health reform, public health services, health and medical research, policy development and planning, with an increased focus on well being, illness prevention, early intervention and quality care.

SA Health is the brand name for the health portfolio of services and agencies responsible to the Minister for Health and the Minister for Mental Health and Substance Abuse. The portfolio consists of the Department of Health, Central Adelaide Local Health Network, Northern Adelaide Local Health Network, Southern Adelaide Local Health Network, Women’s and Children’s Health Network, Country Health SA Local Health Network, and SA Ambulance Service.

SA Health provides many important services to the South Australian community including:

- public hospitals

- metropolitan and country health service delivery

- environmental health

- communicable disease control

- epidemiology

- health promotion

- pathology services

- drug and alcohol services

- emergency and ambulance

- organ donation.

SA Health liaises closely with other agencies in government, particularly:

- Department of Education and Children’s Services

- Department for Families and Communities

- Department of Planning and Local Government

- Department of the Premier and Cabinet

- Department of Treasury and Finance

SA Health also engages with some non government and community service providers on a formal, direct basis and more broadly, on policy and planning matters.

data.title: Textiles Department Supervisor - Erina
data.descriptionHtml:
WHO ARE WE

Known best as the 'Undisputed King of Trainers', JD Sports reigns supreme as one of the biggest and best global Sports Fashion brands across footwear and apparel.

Founded in 1981 in Greater Manchester, UK, JD Group has achieved remarkable growth through rapid global expansion, now standing as the leading global sports fashion retailer. With over 3,400 stores worldwide, we strive to inspire the emerging generation through a captivating connection to the universal culture of sport, music, and fashion.

In 2017, JD Sports launched in Australia and New Zealand and has since grown to over 70+ stores. We now operate across NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA & TAS, with exciting plans for continued expansion.

Our mission? To offer unparalleled service and style to all our consumers. To bring this to life, we offer access to the biggest brands, the best products and a memorable experience that sets us apart.

Working at JD Sports is a state of mind. It's an attitude and a way of challenging the norm. We don’t conform; we create our own path and are elite within our field.

We’re seeking energetic, focused, and passionate individuals to join our team.

THE ROLE

This role is rostered across Sunday to Thursday with varying shift times. By applying, you’re confirming your availability to work across these days.

At JD Sports, our customer is at the heart of everything we do. As a Department Supervisor, you will support the store management team by leading your department in providing exceptional customer service to every JD customer. You will be responsible for maintaining the merchandising & visual standards and sales results within your department. Leading by example, you will coach and develop your team to deliver great in-store experiences.

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for, but not limited to:

  • Model exceptional customer service, every customer, every time

  • Support and guide team to deliver exceptional service and a ‘service over task’ environment

  • Actively gain, maintain and share product & brand knowledge for your department

  • Support management team to improve financial performance within your department

  • Work with back of house team to ensure product availability

  • Uphold company standards and deliver store visual excellence

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2-3 years of experience within retail or like industry

  • You are passionate about delivering an amazing service experience for our customers

  • You have a positive attitude, with capacity to create a motivating environment for your team

  • You have excellent time management skills to ensure that daily priorities are executed in a timely manner

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, someone who thrives in social situations through engagement with customers and team members

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • Work in a dynamic business and engage with some of the best product and biggest sports fashion brands in the market

  • Training and development opportunities to kickstart, evolve and shape your career

  • Opportunity to progress across all areas of the business in a wide array of roles including Retail, Support Office, and our Distribution Centre

  • Access to our attractive staff discount! This can also be used for friends and family

  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program & Mental Health champions

  • One month paid parental leave for full-time employees

We are passionate about connecting with driven and skilled individuals who are invested in their development, so that together we can evolve our brand's success, alongside evolving your career.

JD values diversity and inclusion and champions a culture where everyone feels, valued, included, and celebrated.

What are you waiting for? Apply today and kick start your JD Sports Journey.

Please note, be applying for this role you consent for us to complete a VEVO Check in order to verify your working rights where required.

data.title: BAKER
data.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Edwards Sourdough and Authentic Village Baker is a Victorian family owned business that has consistently produced the highest quality breads for over a decade. Our mission is to provide breads that are not only rich and flavoursome but also breads that are genuinely healthy. Combining ancient techniques of bread-making with modern technology. We deliver bread products enriched with proven techniques from the past and the health benefits of the present.

About You

You will be responsible for making highest quality sourdough bread products from daily production orders in accordance with recipes.

As Baker you will ideally have a minimum of one to three years experience working with dough techniques - mixing, moulding, shaping and or oven work.

As Baker you are qualified and will have been trained in accordance with HACCP guidelines for clean, hygienic and safe baking and use of machinery.

Alternatively you are an Apprentice Baker, Trainee Baker or Bakers Assistant wanting to complete qualification or seeking an on the job mentoring and training program.

· You possess good numeracy, positive attitude, ability to be a team player as well as be able to perform repetitive tasks quickly.

· Skills and experience in other areas of baking highly regarded.

Benefits

· Get an opportunity to work with a warm, supportive team

· Learning & development opportunities to constantly improve your skills

· Flexibility in shifts - morning and midday timings,

· Long term career progression subject to performance.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent, Apprenticeship

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent, Apprenticeship

  • English (Required)

data.title: Customer Service Officer - Liverpool
data.descriptionHtml:
NSW, Whitlam Leisure Centre - Liverpool 2170

  • Great career paths and development with an entrepreneurial organisation
  • Free facility access
  • Opportunity to make a real difference to our community

This is a great opportunity for passionate and friendly people who enjoy delighting our members and visitors and leave lasting positive impressions.


The Role

Our Customer Service Officers are the heart of our business providing important services such as Reception, Merchandising and sales to our members, casual users and potential new members in accordance with our established operational routines and procedures. This is casual role for the weekends and hours may vary. The primary responsibility of our Customer Service Officers is to deliver first class services to our customers.


Key areas of responsibility include:

  • Provide excellent customer service to all customers, both in person and over the telephone
  • Apply sound cash handling principals and use of Point of Sale (POS) systems
  • Provide customers inquiring about memberships with information and have the knowledge to sell memberships when a person joins or renews
  • Promote the centres services and programs to customers and accept customer bookings and enrolments
  • Develop and maintain good working relations with customers
  • Promote and exercise good public relations at all times
  • Opening/closing of the centre in accordance with security and safety procedures

Skills & Attributes:

  • Positive, friendly, helpful and energetic work style
  • Computer literacy, familiarity with software packages and point of sale systems
  • Experience in the leisure industry is desirable.
  • Current First Aid Certificate (Workplace Level 2).
  • Current CPR Certificate.
  • Police Check
  • Working with Children Check

Previous experience is a similar role is desirable, but candidates with a friendly attitude and a customer service mindset are encouraged to apply!


The Company

Belgravia Leisure is part of the Belgravia Health and Leisure Group (BHLG) and is the fastest growing leisure organisation in Australia. Our core areas of business and facilities stewardship include health clubs, wellness and spa, golf, aquatic and sporting venues in 250 locations across Australia and New Zealand.


We are in an exciting period of growth and look to continue to diversify and deliver results while being a strong community citizen. With an annual turnover in excess of $180m, the group are looking for the best and brightest to assist with taking the organisation into the future.


If you like the sound of us, then jump in and submit your application. We’d love to hear from you!

Apply now !!


We are committed to providing a child safe environment. Please refer to our child safety framework. Successful applicants will be required to obtain a national police check and a Working with Children check.


Belgravia Leisure is a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed on merit. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, LGBTQIA+ people, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds and people with a disability. We're happy to adjust our recruitment process to support accessibility needs - reach out to us.

We are looking for a motivated Disability Support Officer to provide a dynamic mix of direct customer support and high-level administrative assistance to our Community Support Team Leaders. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on variety—one day you might be mentoring support workers and working directly with customers to achieve their goals, and the next you’ll be ensuring compliance and supporting the operational backbone of our NDIS services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Focus: Provide high-quality, individualised support to ConnectAbility customers, ensuring their needs and goals are at the centre of service delivery.

  • Administrative Support: Assist Team Leaders with administrative duties, including support plan reviews, staff compliance, customer data management, and reporting for NDIS plan reviews.

  • Quality & Compliance: Implement working knowledge of NDIS Quality and Safeguards requirements, ensuring all service delivery practices meet legislative standards and the NDIS Code of Conduct.

  • Team Collaboration: Act as a positive role model and mentor to support staff, contributing to a collaborative team environment and assisting with the onboarding of new customers.

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Liaise effectively with families, Support Coordinators, and external service providers to enhance customer opportunities and outcomes.

About You

You are a proactive and person-centred professional with a strong background in the disability sector. You have a knack for balancing strategic tasks with operational duties, all while maintaining a positive and enthusiastic attitude.


Essential Selection Criteria:

  • Qualifications: Minimum Certificate III in Disability (or relevant tertiary qualification/extensive industry experience).

  • Experience: Relevant experience in the disability sector.

  • Values Alignment: Ability to demonstrate and authentically promote ConnectAbility’s values in your daily work.

  • Communication & Organisation: Well-developed interpersonal skills and high-level organisational ability to prioritise tasks effectively.

  • Technical Skills: Well-developed documentation skills to produce high-quality reports, and proficiency with IT systems.

  • Compliance:

    • Current NDIS Worker Check

    • Current Working with Children Check (paid employment)

    • NDIS Worker Orientation Module completion certificate

    • Current valid driver’s licence

Highly Desirable:

  • Understanding of NDIS legislation.

Why Join ConnectAbility?

  • Purpose-Driven Work: Be part of an organisation that values relationships, excellence, and trust.

  • Supportive Culture: Work within a leadership framework designed to foster a positive workplace culture and an engaged workforce.

  • Professional Development: Access to learning and development programs to grow your skills and knowledge.

  • Inclusive Environment: We are an EEO employer and strongly encourage people from CALD, Aboriginal, and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds to apply.

Be part of our passionate team dedicated to excellence, strength, and trust. Apply today to start making a difference!

data.title: Storesperson
data.descriptionHtml:
Join Australia's leading inflight catering and retail partner.

Award winning. Global brand. Market leader.

At dnata catering & retail, the sky's truly the limit!


This is a hands-on role that helps keep the Australian aviation industry moving.


So, what does a day in the life of a Storesperson look like?


As a Storesperson, you’re responsible for the timely and efficient acceptance of inbound goods and stores destined for use in our catering area. Your role helps keep our operations running by ensuring incoming orders match what has been ordered and that all deliveries are stored safely and in the right place, in both our dry and cold stores areas.


You will use inventory systems to track stock levels, rotate products, and keep the stores area organised and efficient. Throughout the day, you’ll work closely with your team, move between cool rooms and dry stores, and handle equipment and supplies with care.


It’s a fastpaced, physical role where attention to detail matters and every task contributes to flights leaving fully stocked and ready for service. Your work behind the scenes helps create a smooth inflight experience for thousands of passengers every day.


In a nutshell, your main responsibilities are:

  • Receive and check all incoming orders, ensuring they match the original order.
  • Ensure delivered items are packed to acceptable hygiene and other specifications.
  • Ensure the correct process for receiving perishable items is adhered to at all times.
  • Stock management, ensuring the availability of goods and rotation where necessary.
  • Ensure goods required by the Catering team are available on time and in required quantities.
  • Assist with Warehouse organisation, ensuring stock is stored effectively to maximise space availability for deliveries.
  • Follow all Food Safety, Health and Hygiene policies, including HACCP, IFSA and QSA

What do you need to be successful in securing this role?

  • Clear National Police Check.
  • Current forklift licence (high reach preferred).
  • Experience using manual and automated pallet jacks.
  • Ability to safely perform manual handling tasks, including lifting and moving heavy items.
  • Good knowledge of basic food safety, HACCP, QSAI requirements and Halal policies and procedures.
  • Strong understanding of storehouse procedures, including stock handling, organisation, and safe storage practices.
  • Good understanding of workplace health and safety.
  • Experience using the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Sound numeracy skills for accurate documentation and reporting.
  • Excellence organisation and time management skills.
  • Availability to work 38 hours a week, as this role is a full-time permanent position.
  • Neat and tidy presentation with a strong focus on hygiene.

We provide you with training and support to set you up for success in your new role, with real career pathways and growth opportunities.


What’s in it for you?

  • Be part of a close knit and dedicated team that is committed to safety.
  • Competitive pay rates and generous penalty rates.
  • 5 weeks Annual Leave.
  • Free onsite parking, daily staff meals, and uniforms.
  • Free and confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) available 24/7.
  • Career development and progression, coupled with national relocation opportunities.
  • Discounts at hundreds of retailers, novated leasing, discounted health insurance and wellbeing resources including online exercise classes.

Your prospective employer:


Part of the Emirates Group, we are Australia’s largest inflight catering and retail partner. Chosen by many of the world’s top airlines for our award-winning meals and outstanding service, we operate 16 catering facilities across 12 cities, employ over 4,000 people, produce over 64 million meals, and service over 252 thousand flights each year.


Want to know more about dnata catering & retail? Visits our Australian careers website https://dnatacateringcareers.com.au/


Does this role sound perfect for you? If so, we want to hear from you!

Click the link below and upload your resume to start on the journey of joining the dnata catering & retail team as a Storesperson.


https://dnatacatering.expr3ss.com/home

data.title: Sales Consultant - New Vehicle
data.descriptionHtml:
• Access hundreds of discounts using our exclusive reward platform
  • Plenty of growth, manufacturer training and opportunities available
  • Guaranteed weekly base earnings + healthy commissions + car allowance

About the opportunity:
If you’re passionate about creating exceptional, customer-focused experiences and thrive in a face-to-face sales environment, this is your opportunity to shine. As a Sales Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering outstanding service, building lasting relationships, and guiding customers confidently through their purchasing journey.

Key Responsibilities;

  • Stay ahead of the curve by mastering the latest product features, benefits, and model updates - enabling you to engage customers with confidence and expertise.
  • Build lasting relationships through a structured follow-up approach that nurtures leads, drives repeat business, and strengthens customer loyalty.
  • Maximise every sales opportunity by understanding customer needs, tailoring solutions, and contributing to strong sales performance and profitability.
  • Deliver exceptional service by responding to enquiries promptly and professionally, while proactively prospecting to grow your customer base.
  • Create memorable customer experiences by confidently coordinating and conducting engaging test drives.

About you:
To thrive in this role, you’ll bring a customer-first mindset, strong communication skills, and the confidence to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.

You will have:

  • A proven success in automotive sales (highly regarded), with a strong track record of achieving - and exceeding - targets.
  • Passionate about delivering industry-leading service and creating memorable, customer-first experiences.
  • Are driven, energetic and team-focused, with the resilience to embrace challenges and the enthusiasm to enjoy the wins.
  • You are a confident communicator who builds rapport easily and influences with authenticity.
  • Are available to work Saturdays as part of a dynamic retail environment.
  • Holds a current and valid driver’s licence.

The benefits

  • Enjoy an industry-competitive remuneration package complemented by a highly rewarding bonus structure that recognises performance.
  • Unlock access to hundreds of exclusive discounts through our rewards platform - including gym memberships, BUPA Private Health Insurance, the Samsung Partnership Program, retail offers, and special pricing on vehicles, parts, and servicing.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave to support you and your family when it matters most.
  • Access our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for confidential support and resources whenever you need them.
  • Benefit from ongoing manufacturer-led and internal training to accelerate your professional growth.
  • Work a balanced six-day roster designed to support both performance and lifestyle.

If you think this role is right for you, apply today by completing our online application and don’t miss out on a great opportunity!


Peter Warren Automotive Holdings is one of Australia's largest multi-franchise automotive dealer groups. We have expanded across Southwest Sydney, Sydney’s North Shore, Regional NSW, Northern NSW, and throughout Southeast Queensland and Victoria. With over 2000 dedicated employees across multiple locations, our team is built on a foundation of extensive industry knowledge, outstanding sales and customer service, and leading expertise. We value our people as one of our greatest assets and are looking for passionate individuals to join our growing team.

Peter Warren Automotive is a family-owned company founded in 1958 and is the namesake of the visionary who started his automotive business by operating a small used car yard located next to Liverpool Railway Station. Today it remains one of the most trusted and well-established automotive retailing group in Sydney.

Headquartered at Warwick Farm on a 22-acre site, the company which started trading with just 3 used cars has grown to become a leading privately owned dealership group with one of the largest parts distribution centres in Sydney. Peter Warren Automotive represents over 17 of the world’s best car brands including Mercedes-Benz, Chrysler, Jeep, Dodge, Honda, Toyota, Ford, Suzuki, Kia, Peugeot, Volvo, ŠKODA and Isuzu UTE.

data.descriptionHtml:
Exciting Career Opportunity

  • Attractive remuneration and 10% company discount for you and your family
  • Full on-the-job training and support provided
  • Permanent full-time position (20 hours per week)

About us:


Over 50 years since Roger Drake purchased his first supermarket in 1974, Drakes Supermarkets has now become the largest independent grocery retailer in Australia. While we’ve grown from one store to more than 60 stores across South Australia and Queensland, Drakes Supermarkets has retained the same values since day one.


Our mission at Drakes is to provide our customers with exceptional service, value for money, a great range and an outstanding shopping experience. To achieve this, we acknowledge that our customers are the most important people in our business.


What we offer you:


Become a valuable part of highly supportive diverse work culture, with more than 5,500 team members nationally, we’re committed to creating an inspiring workplace at Drakes, which supports the development of great people.

  • 10% staff and family discount across all Drakes stores
  • Wide range of corporate benefits including discounted gym memberships, banking, health insurance and much more!
  • In-depth onboarding and career progression opportunities
  • Company funded retail management qualifications and first aid qualifications
  • Vehicle leasing opportunities

About this opportunity:


Our Sun Valley store store in Gladstone is currently looking for a motivated and hard working leader, to join and assist leading the store's fruit & veg department.


Reporting directly to the Fruit & Veg Manager, this successful applicant will be responsible for managing a small team, creating rosters, generating orders, completing stock takes + much more!


Working as a part of an enthusiastic team, in a highly competitive supermarket environment, applicants will be expected to demonstrate:

  • Fresh food retail knowledge is desired, but not essential
  • Ability to lead and manage a team
  • Ability to order and control costs
  • Accurate team rostering
  • Passion and enthusiasm, with a very "hands on" approach
  • Unparalleled commitment to customer service
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to liaise with both team members and management
  • A flair for merchandising
  • Strong leadership and delegation skills
  • Ability to coach, train and performance manage teams
  • Commitment to work health and safety standard


If this sounds like the opportunity you’ve been looking for, we’d love to hear from you!

data.title: Member Relations Officer
data.descriptionHtml:
A little about us

Capricorn is one of Australia and New Zealand's largest and most dynamic Member-owned organisations. Since 1974, we've provided our Members with financial and business solutions to make running a business easier. Our flagship Trade Account offers instant credit with over 1600 Preferred Suppliers, simplified monthly expenses, and a generous rewards program.

We have a strong foundation in the automotive and machinery aftermarkets. Our vibrant community includes over 31,000 Members across Australia and New Zealand, from national franchises to your local family workshop. Last year, Capricorn facilitated nearly $4bn in sales with our Preferred Suppliers.

At Capricorn, we're about more than just products and services. We work hard to ensure that our Members, Suppliers and People feel like they're part of something bigger - a Community which is connected and supported to make a difference, while having some fun along the way!

Your role

  • Answer incoming calls from relevant phone and email queues as required.
  • Ensure after hours voicemail messages are returned in a timely manner.
  • Action and responding to enquiries within the service level agreements.
  • Ensure immediate escalation of all unresolved queries as per the complaints procedure.
  • Liaise with suppliers and service providers as well as other internal departments to ensure the successful and efficient resolution of queries.
  • Liaise with Area Managers as required to ensure they are kept well informed of Member & Supplier concerns and escalate queries to field staff if required.
  • Add CRM calls to record all contacts with Members, Suppliers, and other staff.
  • Enter manual updates accurately into Epicor as required and update CRM.
  • Ensure call centre statistics targets are met
  • Provide Trade Account payment support

Skills, Knowledge and Attributes

  • Intermediate skill in the use of Microsoft Office Software Suite
  • Exposure to basic accounting principles (desirable)
  • Problem Solving skills

Experience

  • 2 years' experience within a Customer Service oriented role essential

Qualifications

  • Completion of Year 10 High School Certificate or equivalent preferred
  • Customer Service Certificate (desirable).

A little on life at Capricorn

Our community at Capricorn always comes first, and a big part of that community is our team. We genuinely believe that investment in our people is the key to everything that we do.

Joining our community is about more than just a job, so here's what's in it for you:

  • Work flexibility – We support flexible ways of working wherever possible. In the Contact Centre, this includes rostered shift hours and a hybrid model of three days from home and two days in the office, with flexibility subject to business needs.
  • Development Opportunities – your success is ours too. We provide opportunities training and development that give you the tools you need to grow.
  • Paid parental leave – during life's most important times, we support both parents' leave and their transition back to work.
  • Get social – our social calendar is full up with a range of different virtual and face-to-face events to keep us connected.
  • A place you want to be – from the sweeping city views, coffee on tap and the general buzz of our team, Capricorn is a place you want to be.
  • A cherry on top – we've got a heap of benefits that our team actually use, including a fantastic reward and recognition program, wellness program, additional leave purchase and so much more!

Sound like you'd be a good fit?

If you are ready to become part of a growing community and make a real impact, get in touch today.

For further information, support with your application and detail on Capricorn, please visit our website at capricorn.coop/careers

Sound like you'd be a good fit?

If you are ready to become part of a growing community and make a real impact, get in touch today.

data.title: Traffic Officer / Maintainer Leading Hand
data.descriptionHtml:
Join the Bundaberg Sugar Cane Supply Team!

Boasting a legacy of over 130 years in the sugar industry, Bundaberg Sugar holds a prominent position in the Australian sugar sector. Serving as a grower, miller, refiner, and marketer of sugar and associated products. The company stands as one of Australia's largest cane growers, operating a Sugar Mill, Refinery and Packaging plant in Bundaberg, Queensland.

Bundaberg Sugar has an opportunity for three dual roles undertaking the duties of a Traffic Officer during the crushing season and duties of Maintainer Leading Hand during maintenance season.

What You Will Be Doing:

During crush season, the Traffic Officer ensures the safe, orderly, and efficient flow of traffic and is responsible for the scheduled movement of track-mounted vehicles, cane transport, traffic office and cane railway maintenance operations.

During maintenance season, the Maintainer Leading Hand leads and facilitates Navvy crews to perform cane railway maintenance and undertake duties of an asset maintainer.

The successful applicant's responsibilities include;

  • Control of the safe and efficient movement of track mounted vehicles, maintenance personnel and third-party persons across the entire cane rail network.
  • Perform prompt, timely, clear and relevant communication with all parties and other personnel regarding harvest and transport issues using a range of communications equipment.
  • Develop and adjust schedules during the crushing season to meet the requirements of the Mill and Growers.
  • Adjust harvesting quotas using TOTools and other transport management software to ensure a continuous cane supply and equity between harvest groups.
  • Observe closely all performance, rates of production, equipment performance, quality control criteria and losses and record and report observations.
  • Prepare and distribute a range of administrative reports associated with the cane transport function.
  • Supervision of timesheets and associated administrative tasks for cane transport personnel.
  • Lead and facilitate Navvy crews to perform cane railway maintenance and/or maintenance as directed by the supervisor.
  • Undertake the duties of an asset maintainer.

What We Are Looking For:

  • A sound understanding of the Cane Supply Code of Practice and Asset Management System
  • Experience in the development of safe working documents
  • Experience in the Risk Assessment process for level crossings
  • Experience in a scheduling role working in a complex, multi-faceted environment.
  • Current drivers licence
  • A Certificate 3 in Rail Maintenance is desirable.

Why Join us?

Bundaberg Sugar has been part of the local community for generations, and we continue to play a vital role in one of the region's most important industries.

We offer a competitive remuneration package, the opportunity to work alongside like-minded individuals in a challenging and stimulating work environment as well as genuine opportunities for career growth and personal development.

Bundaberg Sugar Ltd upholds a commitment to Equal Opportunity Employment.

Communication will be conducted via email. Please ensure you regularly check your inbox, including your junk or spam folder, to avoid missing important updates regarding your application.

Apply Now and help us keep the cane moving!

data.title: In-Store Sales Representative (Peakhurst)
data.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an In-Store Sales Representative for our store in Peakhurst.


Who You'll Be Working For: Hardware & General is a large, family-owned building and plumbing supplier based in Sydney, Australia. Founded in 1960 by Walter MacGregor, we've grown from a single corner store to six locations across Sydney, yet we've remained proudly family-run, now in our third generation!


Why Work With Us: We're known for our high-quality products, expert staff, and outstanding customer service.

We provide fast, reliable delivery services and expert advice.


Our extensive product range includes over 140,000 items, from building materials and plumbing supplies to hardware and renovation essentials.


We operate across six locations, including our flagship Brookvale site (home to multiple specialist sales centres) and stores in Peakhurst, Mona Vale, Terrey Hills, Hornsby, and Dural.


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Assist customers with selection and purchase decisions.
  • Operate "Point of Sale" system to record transactions.
  • Process and follow up quotes to qualify, refine and close sales opportunities and enter details into the quote register and Frameworks.
  • Complete paperwork, ensuring procedures are followed as instructed.
  • Assist with preparation, packing and dispatch of orders & receipt to ensure safe storage of stock.
  • Manage stock levels and liaising with suppliers as directed by the local manager
  • Provide exceptional customer service and demonstrate product knowledge.
  • Ensure the store is well-maintained, organised, and visually appealing.
  • Contribute to achieving sales targets and supporting daily operations.
  • Undertake self-directed learning through Trade Net for relevant products.

What You'll Bring:

  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in a customer service role, such as retail or trade
  • Basic computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  • Must have the legal right to work in Australia
  • Knowledge of building materials and plumbing supplies preferred but not essential as training will be provided
  • Ability to lift and move stock items safely, and stand for extended periods

What You'll Get in Return:

  • Attractive staff discounts across all our premium brands.
  • Friendly environment and many employee benefits!!


Join a business with a proud family history and take the next step in your leadership career. Apply now to grow with Hardware & General!

data.title: Casual Optical Assistant - Erina Fair
data.descriptionHtml:
Bailey Nelson is on the lookout for a Casual Optical Assistant to join our Erina Fair team!


At Bailey Nelson, we’re on a mission to change how people see the world—and how the world sees them. We’re a down-to-earth team that’s obsessed with improving every day, and we’re growing fast.


Our secret? Our people. The connections and experiences we build - with each other and with our customers are what set us apart and make us a brand of choice.


Ready to be part of it?


What you’ll be doing


As an Optical Assistant, you’ll be at the heart of the customer experience, helping people find their perfect frames, supporting their eyecare needs, and making every visit unforgettable.


What’s in it for you?


  • A role where you can make a real impact every single day
  • Access to our world-class online learning platform to keep you sharp and in the know with all things BN
  • 1 free pair of glasses per quarter product allowance so you can rep the brand in style and a year's supply of contacts!
  • A supportive leadership team that genuinely invests in your growth

What we’re looking for


  • Customer-first mindset – You’ve got experience in retail, hospitality, or similar and know how to deliver standout service
  • Optical experience? Great. No experience? No worries. If you’re keen to learn, we’re keen to teach
  • Passion & energy – You bring positivity, enthusiasm, and a can-do attitude
  • Fast-paced adaptability – You thrive in a dynamic, ever-evolving environment
  • Strong time management – You get things done without compromising customer experience
  • Problem-solving skills – You love helping people find the right solution
  • Team player – You build great relationships with everyone around you
  • Results-driven – You love hitting goals through amazing service
  • Flexibility – Must be available Saturdays, Sundays and Mondays with some flexibility to pick up other weekday and weekend shifts.

This is your chance to step into an exciting role, elevate your career and experience, and be part of a brand that’s growing fast.


Ready to frame your future? Apply now.


Bailey Nelson is proud to be an inclusive, diverse workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities.

data.title: Casual Merchandiser - North Sydney, Balgowlah, NSW
data.descriptionHtml:
Area: North Sydney, Balgowlah, NSW
Flexible Casual


THE OPPORTUNITY


Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and beverage company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.

Nestlé has merchandiser opportunities for motivated and talented individuals who are looking for a career in sales. You will join a large global company that is leading in Nutrition, Health and Wellness and you will be able to learn, develop and grow to your full potential with career opportunities across different brands and products that help people, families and pets live happier, healthier lives.


A DAY IN THE LIFE…


You will represent Nestlé in the Grocery channel (Coles, Woolworths, Independent stores) and be required to negotiate, sell & build displays to optimise store presence for our products based on a weekly work plan.

Flexibility is important: Availability between Wednesday to Friday is essential with the ability to work additional hours on a Monday and Tuesday during busy periods such as Back to School and during Winter. You will work between 46-50 weeks of the year, excluding a shutdown period mid-December to the first week in January.

You will be supported by a Territory Sales Manager. However, to be successful in this role, you will need to work autonomously.

This role will allow you to build strong, long-term relationships with Store Managers and represent Nestlé with pride, positivity, and passion.


ARE YOU A FIT?


This role is perfect for an ambitious and well-presented individual with a passion for sales and marketing, looking for casual work or looking to kick-start their career with Nestlé. Ideally you will:

  • Have a current, valid driver's license and a safe reliable motor vehicle is essential.
  • Be physically able to lift stock for building of displays and utilise Nestle’s creative point of sale.
  • Be proficient using a mobile device (provided) to collate data and photograph displays.
  • Live within the designated Area
  • Be able to work safely and plan effectively to achieve commercial outcomes.


Applicants must have full working rights for Australia.

Applicants will be required to undergo pre-employment checks or National Police check, including but not limited to health checks, prior to appointment to this role.


OUR STORY


Nestlé enjoys a reputation as one of the world’s largest FMCG companies and we are driven by our purpose - enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Our inclusive and high-performance culture is a testament to the great training, development, rewards and recognition we extend to every member of our 5,000-strong Oceania workforce. Nestlé Oceania supports a culture of diversity and inclusion in all that we do. Take a look at https://www.nestle.com.au/careers/ to see some of the ways we live and practice this every day in our workplace.

For more information please visit our website @ www.nestle.com.au/careers or Our LinkedIn page http://www.linkedin.com/company/nestle-s-a-


Interested? Apply online today.


Please note that this role may close earlier than the advertised deadline at our discretion, so we encourage early applications.

data.title: Security Operations Supervisor
data.descriptionHtml:
Security Operations Supervisor

Core Security Group – Perth & Remote WA Sites

Full-time | Leadership | Security Operations

Core Security Group is seeking an experienced Security Operations Supervisor to support and lead security operations across Perth, regional and remote Western Australian sites. This role suits a professional with strong operational coordination, time management and workforce supervision and client engagement experience within security, defence, law enforcement, emergency services or similar environments.

About Core Security Group

Core Security Group is a Veteran-owned security provider delivering professional guarding, risk management and protective services across WA. Through our partnership with Core Training Group (RTO), we develop highly skilled, compliant and professionally managed security personnel. Our culture is built on discipline, professionalism and service excellence.

The Role

Reporting to the Strategic Operations Lead, you will coordinate daily security operations, supervise frontline teams, maintain site coverage, support compliance requirements and act as a key escalation point for staff and clients. You will also contribute to project support, service improvement and operational growth opportunities.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong judgement, communication and the ability to manage multiple priorities across diverse environments.

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate and supervise security operations across Perth, regional and remote sites.

- Manage rosters, workforce deployment, travel, accommodation and equipment readiness.

- Support recruitment, onboarding, licensing and compliance requirements.

- Supervise, mentor and support security personnel to maintain high standards.

- Manage and coordinate the 24/7 operations phone, including incidents, escalations and after-hours support.

- Conduct client engagement, site visits, inspections and operational reviews.

- Ensure compliance with legislation, licensing, WHS/HSE and company procedures.

- Assist with incident management, emergency response and operational risk processes.

- Prepare operational reports, incident summaries and compliance documentation.

- Identify service improvements and support business growth initiatives.

Your strengths and contributions

- Experience in security operations coordination, supervision or a related operational field.

- Strong leadership, workforce management and client engagement capability.

- Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple sites and operational requirements.

- Experience handling incidents, escalations and after-hours operational issues.

- Strong communication, problem solving and decision-making skills.

- Competence in reporting, documentation and Microsoft Office systems.

- Understanding of security procedures, risk management and compliance frameworks.

- Current (or ability to obtain) WA Security Officer, Crowd Controller and Monitoring Officer licences.

- Have a National police clearance

- Current manual C Class driver’s licence and ability to travel as required.

Highly Regarded

- min 3+ years in security operations, defence, law enforcement or similar environments.

- Experience coordinating remote-site operations and 24/7 support.

- Advanced rostering, workforce planning and resource coordination experience.

- Experience preparing operational documents, procedures or site instructions.

- Qualifications in security risk, WHS, leadership or project management.

- WA Security Consultant licence endorsement.

Personal Attributes

- Professional, disciplined and accountable leadership style.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Clear, confident communication with staff, clients and stakeholders.

- Proactive, solutions-focused approach to operational challenges.

- Ability to work independently while upholding company standards.

Why Join Us?

You’ll be joining a respected and growing WA security provider where you’ll lead meaningful operations that strengthen client confidence and community safety, while working within a high‑performing, supportive team culture built on discipline, integrity and a commitment to quality. The role also offers strong development opportunities and exposure to diverse operational environments.

Applying for the role

To be considered for this role, you must have unrestricted working rights in Australia. Australian citizenship is preferred due to operational requirements.

We are looking for someone with a positive, energetic approach who brings enthusiasm to their work and team interactions.

Submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and suitability.

Email: michelle@coresecurity.com.au

Subject: Application – Security Operations Supervisor

Pay: $75,000.00 – $90,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

  • Are you comfortable managing a 24/7 operations phone, including after‑hours issues?

Work Authorisation:

  • Australia (Required)

Work Location: In person

- Manage rosters, workforce deployment, travel, accommodation and equipment readiness.

- Support recruitment, onboarding, licensing and compliance requirements.

- Supervise, mentor and support security personnel to maintain high standards.

- Manage and coordinate the 24/7 operations phone, including incidents, escalations and after-hours support.

- Conduct client engagement, site visits, inspections and operational reviews.

- Ensure compliance with legislation, licensing, WHS/HSE and company procedures.

- Assist with incident management, emergency response and operational risk processes.

- Prepare operational reports, incident summaries and compliance documentation.

- Identify service improvements and support business growth initiatives.

*Your strengths and contributions*

- Experience in security operations coordination, supervision or a related operational field.

- Strong leadership, workforce management and client engagement capability.

- Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple sites and operational requirements.

- Experience handling incidents, escalations and after-hours operational issues.

- Strong communication, problem solving and decision-making skills.

- Competence in reporting, documentation and Microsoft Office systems.

- Understanding of security procedures, risk management and compliance frameworks.

- Current (or ability to obtain) WA Security Officer, Crowd Controller and Monitoring Officer licences.

- Have a National police clearance

- Current manual C Class driver’s licence and ability to travel as required.

*Highly Regarded*

- min 3+ years in security operations, defence, law enforcement or similar environments.

- Experience coordinating remote-site operations and 24/7 support.

- Advanced rostering, workforce planning and resource coordination experience.

- Experience preparing operational documents, procedures or site instructions.

- Qualifications in security risk, WHS, leadership or project management.

- WA Security Consultant licence endorsement.

*Personal Attributes*

- Professional, disciplined and accountable leadership style.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Clear, confident communication with staff, clients and stakeholders.

- Proactive, solutions-focused approach to operational challenges.

- Ability to work independently while upholding company standards.

*Why Join Us?*

You’ll be joining a respected and growing WA security provider where you’ll lead meaningful operations that strengthen client confidence and community safety, while working within a high‑performing, supportive team culture built on discipline, integrity and a commitment to quality. The role also offers strong development opportunities and exposure to diverse operational environments.

*Applying for the role*

To be considered for this role, you must have unrestricted working rights in Australia. Australian citizenship is preferred due to operational requirements.

We are looking for someone with a positive, energetic approach who brings enthusiasm to their work and team interactions.

Submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and suitability.

Email: michelle@coresecurity.com.au

Pay: $75,000.00 – $90,000.00 per year
